spec.caption:
Sample resume rewrite:
'Built a dApp' becomes 'Built a React token-balance view with disconnected, loading and RPC-error states.'

Use the project's Description field.

1. Sample community resume:
'Managed Discord' becomes 'Drafted a mock support queue with issue category, escalation owner and resolution note.'

Your Role: Personal practice project.

2. Sample content resume:
'Wrote about crypto' becomes 'Wrote a practice guide explaining approve and transferFrom with a worked allowance example.'

Project Name: Sample Token Approval Guide.

3. Sample summaries: frontend developer building a balance view; community contributor drafting a support queue; content writer explaining token approvals.

Put the sentence in Professional Summary.

4. Practice interview walkthroughs:

Technical: disconnect the wallet, load a balance, then simulate an RPC error.
Support: classify the issue, assign an owner and record the resolution.

5. Use Key Projects & Portfolio for practice work, with separate Project Name, Your Role, Description and Link fields.
